cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you not to buy sour grapes twice. Taste one from this bunch before we pay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also taught me to read signs. This one says no tasting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent reading. Now try judgment. You taste first; I'll try one if the assistant doesn't object.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then hold the bunch where she can see you. I'm not sneaking one while you walk away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fair correction. I'll stay right here with it. Show me you can choose a grape without your teacher doing it first.

reason: Make B invoke an actual contradictory lesson and A replace reading with judgment, retaining first-breach pressure after agreeing to visible support.
